cpu_arithmetic.reference: host fp16/fp32/fp64 add/mul, half narrowing, and libm fmaf/fma

readable.source: tests/compare_ghidra.py SM89 real 20000 --fp readable (exact: same sample 20000/20000)

synthetic.source: tests/compare_ghidra.py SM89 synthetic (default 2,000-word sample plus generated class cases)

fp_modes.exact: directed rounding native: RN-wide result, TwoSum/exact-product residual, RN narrowing, one-ulp encoding correction; RM exact-cancellation zero sign
fp_modes.hardware_scope: SM89 .RZ/.RM/.RP for FADD/FMUL/FFMA/DADD/DMUL/DFMA, 128 vectors each incl. sub-precision residuals, cancellations, overflow
limitations: round-to-nearest FFMA/DFMA keep rare midpoint double rounding in exact mode
fp_modes.readable: native-width f+/f*; rounding modes as RN; no FTZ/FMZ, fusion, or FMNMX NaN/signed-zero rules; SAT and abs/neg kept

exclusions: cross-thread shared memory and memory ordering
gpu.floating_tolerance: MMA move constants and FSEL/FMNMX exact bits; other floats except NaN payload/sign, independently per half
gpu.scope: compiled whole kernels from entry through EXIT; tested scalar selectors and independent threads

gpu_carry.note: eight BAR slots and the placeholder arithmetic word replaced; compiled prologue/addressing/EXIT preserved
gpu_carry.references: independent integer arithmetic and Ghidra PcodeEmulator, both compared to GPU

pcode_reduction.instruction: LOP3.LUT R8, R2, R4, R6, 0x96, PT

pytest.deselected_reason: pydecode tests; decode IR unchanged, full Ghidra SM89 synthetic suite run separately
pytest.skip_reason: opt-in execution/dataflow/GPU wrappers; all run separately

exclusions: cross-thread shared memory and memory ordering
gpu.floating_tolerance: bit-exact FSEL/FMNMX; other floating arithmetic except NaN payload/sign
gpu.scope: compiled whole kernels from entry through EXIT; tested scalar selectors and independent threads

cpu_arithmetic.reference: host float add/mul and libm fmaf

exclusions: cross-thread shared memory and memory ordering

step2.emulation_only: uniform aliases on other architectures; FSEL.FTZ
step2.hardware_scope: SM89 FSEL and FMNMX ordinary min/max including FMNMX.FTZ; exact bits

step3.hardware_scope: SM89 RN DADD/DMUL/DFMA and DSETP.LTU; 128 random/edge vectors per family
limitations: DFMA binary128 sum/narrowing can double-round in rare midpoint cases
Ghidra FloatFormat minimum-subnormal underflow band excluded in emulator reference cases

fallbacks: MMA forms other than the zero-source immediate move
step4.hardware_scope: SM89 HADD2/HFMA2 ordinary and SAT, broadcasts/modifiers, and MMA zero-source immediate moves including signed-zero, NaN, infinity, and denormal constants
limitations: Ghidra minimum-subnormal underflow band excluded in emulator reference cases
step4.mma_scope: nofmz/nosat -RZ,RZ,immediate; NaN halves canonicalize to positive 0x7fff at decode time; one COPY
step4.native_scope: RN packed F16_V2, H1_H0/H0_H0/H1_H1, abs/negate per lane, SAT, registers/uniforms/constants/immediate halves

carry_conventions.IADD3: unary carry thresholds 2^32/2^33; Pu wins aliased outputs; two predicate inputs for .X
carry_conventions.IMAD: HI/WIDE unsigned 64-bit overflow of product plus pair addend plus predicate
carry_conventions.LEA: shifted selected word modified before addition; one predicate input for .X

fallbacks: IADD3/LEA with both Ra and Rb modified
SM75/80 HI/WIDE constant addends declared 32 bits
limitations: hardware evidence limited to SM89; other architectures checked in the emulator
step5.native_scope: IADD3 ordinary/.X predicate results; LEA LO/HI/SX32 ordinary/.X; IMAD LO/HI/WIDE .X and HI/WIDE carry; uniform aliases
step5.preserves: compact arithmetic when carry destinations are discarded; inputs captured before overlapping outputs
